content:
Nadia: Need help — landed in HCM and used a local "GrabBike" (motorbike taxi) and a tuk-tuk. Driver only accepted cash and gave me a handwritten slip. Lost the slip now. Also the company card was used earlier for the coworking daypass. Can I submit for reimbursement w/ bank withdrawal screenshot + photo of handwritten slip (blurry) + note? Any special handling for small foreign cash receipts?

Sam: Short version: yes, but need good attestation. For foreign cash payments under $30 USD equivalent we accept bank withdrawal + honest attestation plus a photo of the receipt. For non-card micro-transactions (bikes, tips) show conversion method (date) and annotate the expense as "cash-foreign-micro".

Yusuf: Adding nuance for coworking: if company card was used for booking and charge is in a different name than the vendor, include the booking confirmation + last4 and statement line. Finance will need to reconcile. If you accidentally charged a third party (another person) to the company card, that requires manager approval and a correction.

Nadia: Noted — I didn't charge anyone else. Just wondering about per-diem: I'm here for 2 full days + arrival day. Do we pro-rate per-diem for arrival/departure?

Sam: Policy refresher: per-diem pro-rates by full calendar days. Arrival and departure partial days are handled as actuals unless you selected per-diem in advance. Since this was booked last-minute and you didn't pre-select, submit actual meal receipts OR elect per-diem retroactively only with manager sign-off and only on whole-day basis.

Nadia: Okay. The handwritten slip is pretty smudged. Can I upload a photo + the cash withdrawal showing exact amount and a short note: "motorbike to client site 08:45 04/21"?

FinanceBot: Auto-check: For cash receipts < $30 convert using transaction date 2026-04-21. Attach exchange rate screenshot or use Expensify conversion tool. If supporting docs are low-quality, manual review required.

Legal: Quick privacy note: do not include driver ID numbers or passport scans. Redact any PII on slips before upload. Also, handwritten notes are fine; we accept employee attestations for micro cash in low-infrastructure regions.

Nadia: Also small weirdness: the Grab app charged me in local wallet credits and gave an emailed receipt with no merchant VAT number. Is that okay?

Sam: Acceptable if receipt includes merchant name, date, and amount. If no VAT/tax ID, add a note "no tax id provided by merchant". Finance will accept for low-value items.

Nadia: Great. I'll upload: (1) photo of handwritten slip (2) ATM withdrawal screenshot (3) Grab email receipt (4) short attestation and tag Manager-Amy.

Manager-Amy: I approve the retro per-diem exception if Nadia requests it, otherwise approve actual receipts. Confirming she did not charge any third party to the company card. Approved in DM 2026-04-21.

expensify-bot: Draft created: 2065432100-NADIA-HCM-MICROCASH. Missing docs: ATM screenshot, attestation. Auto-hold after 72h if docs missing.

Nadia: Uploaded all. Tagged Sam and FinanceBot. Marked memo: "cash-foreign-micro; project: SALES-EUAPAC"

FinanceBot: Manual review queued. Expect reimbursement in next payroll. Guideline: if reviewer still needs clarity, they will request a manager screenshot.

Sam: Thanks — flagging this as "low-infra cash" category so reviewers know policy. If anyone else runs into drivers who don't provide legible receipts, follow same flow.

Nadia: Thanks team — resolved.
